newsitem.title: ISRAEL: PLO's Arafat to meet Mubarak in Egypt on Saturday.
newsitem.headline: PLO's Arafat to meet Mubarak in Egypt on Saturday.

text.p: Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat will travel to Egypt on Saturday for talks with Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak in the wake of a double suicide bombing in a Jerusalem market, an aide said on Friday.

"President Arafat will meet President Mubarak in Burj al-Arab to discuss latest developments and the crisis in the peace process especially after the dangerous decision of the Israeli cabinet following the attacks," Arafat aide Nabil Abu Rdaineh told Reuters.
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's cabinet demanded Arafat crack down on Moslem militants responsible for Wednesday's attack that killed 13 people and wounded 170.

Israel also suspended peace talks with Arafat, launched arrests, confined Palestinians to their home districts, demanded the extradition of the PLO police chief and threatened to re-enter PLO areas to seize militants if Arafat failed to do the job.
The demands came with Arafat facing domestic pressure over alleged corruption and mismanagement in his Palestinian Authority.
Abu Rdaineh has called Israel's demands a "declaration of war".
He said Arafat spoke with Egyptian Foreign Minister Amr Moussa by telephone on Friday and would depart for Egypt early on Saturday morning.
Egypt has been trying to help shake Israeli-PLO peacemaking from a four-month deadlock sparked by Netanyahu's groundbreaking on a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem.
